figure: AlignScore d/p pair chunking: Precision/Recall/F1, hallucination-direction only, threshold sweep from 0.20 onward
paper_section: 9.4.3/9.4.4 -- companion to Figure 8 (edit-stage bar chart) and Figure 9 (Edit 1's own threshold sweep)
description: Same 10-file sample throughout (prim1.txt, prim10.txt-prim18.txt). Scores are hallucination-direction only (by_type.hallucination), matching Figure 8's scope exactly -- the omission direction is not implemented for this checker (Section 9.4.5), so these numbers exclude omission-type labels from the denominator rather than counting them as automatic misses. This is the d/p pair chunking pipeline (Edit 1's splitter plus doctor/patient turn-pair context chunking, the adopted replacement for the abandoned Edit 2). Threshold 0.30 is Edit 3, and its tp/fp/fn here (12/26/10, F1=0.400) match Figure 8's 'Edit 3' bar exactly.

sources.edit1: Modules/old/alignscore_checker.py THRESHOLD comment block (verbatim); identical to data_jsons/fig09_alignscore_threshold_sweep.json. Kept here for provenance/reference only -- not plotted in the current version of this figure. Hallucination-direction only (no omission scoring existed for this variant); only 0.20/0.25/0.30/0.35/0.50 survive.
sources.dp_pair_chunking_overall: Same log files, top-level 'overall' block (all labels, omission counted as automatic FN) -- kept for reference; not what's plotted. F1 at 0.30 under this scope is 0.369, not 0.400 -- see the fig28/Figure 8 scope discussion if reusing this.

note: d/p pair chunking's own best-F1 point across the full sweep (hallucination-only) is threshold=0.10 (F1=0.426, not shown since the chart's x-range starts at 0.20); within 0.20-0.50 its F1 peaks again at 0.30 (F1=0.400), which is the threshold actually adopted as Edit 3 and matches Figure 8.
